cases.sentence: Все ___, которые израильтяне приносят священнику, принадлежат ему.
cases.explain: «священные дары» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Every heave offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they present to the priest, shall be his.

cases.sentence: Пусть он нальет в ___ священной воды и положит в воду землю с пола скинии.
cases.explain: «глиняный сосуд» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: The priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and the priest shall take some of the dust that is on the floor of the tabernacle and put it into the water.

cases.sentence: Пусть он нальет в глиняный сосуд ___ и положит в воду землю с пола скинии.
cases.explain: «священной воды» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and the priest shall take some of the dust that is on the floor of the tabernacle and put it into the water.

cases.explain: «другой мужчина» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The priest shall cause her to take an oath and shall tell the woman, “If no man has lain with you, and if you haven’t gone aside to uncleanness, being under your husband’s authority, be free from this water of bitterness that brings a curse.

cases.sentence: Пусть он напоит женщину ___, которая наводит проклятие; эта вода войдет в нее и заставит ее жестоко страдать.
cases.explain: «горькой водой» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: He shall make the woman drink the water of bitterness that causes the curse; and the water that causes the curse shall enter into her and become bitter.

cases.sentence: Он возьмет пригоршню ___ как памятную часть и сожжет на жертвеннике.
cases.explain: «хлебного приношения» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The priest shall take a handful of the meal offering, as its memorial portion, and burn it on the altar, and afterward shall make the woman drink the water.
